_meta.caveats: Phone numbers are included only where they appeared on the organization's own site or an official page checked on 2026-10-11; otherwise null. Some LawHelp-network portals (e.g. PALawHelp, LawHelpCA, GeorgiaLegalAid, LawHelpMO, Help4TN) and a few org sites could not be fetched from the build environment and are listed from the known network domain. Several states have no statewide bar-run lawyer referral service; a large-county bar (e.g. Maricopa, Atlanta, Indianapolis, Louisville) or the bar's find-a-lawyer page is used instead. Tenant entries are null where no statewide tenant hotline/right-to-counsel program was confirmed; some listed tenant programs are city-only (NYC, Philadelphia; Chicago listed without a confirmed number). Tennessee has no statewide bar referral service, so the Help4TN statewide helpline is used. Service areas and eligibility (income limits, case types) vary; users should confirm before relying on any listing. ZIP3 table excludes military APO/FPO prefixes, USVI (008), Guam/Pacific (969), and unassigned prefixes; a few prefixes straddle state lines at the 5-digit level, so treat ZIP3 as a best-guess default the user can override.
